cond_0001.intro:
The Senior Manufacturing Engineer will lead the manufacturing engineering department to support production operations. The position requires a results-oriented individual with a history of driving change in their work environment, strong analytical skills, and previous experience in an engineer to order / make to order project environment. Primary objectives are to drive continuous improvement and document processes and procedures critical to sustainable manufacturing performance.
Peer relationships include Production, Operations Project Manager, Design Engineering, Planning, Estimating and Facilitates departments.
This individual will facilitate and/or lead cross-functional teams with Engineering, Production and Estimating in support of driving efficiencies, eliminating non-value-added activities, and employing structured improvement methodologies, including LEAN principles. Responsible for training, building, and certifying a capability of continuous and sustainable improvement.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Lead the ME Team in driving Process Improvement Program to meet the savings target. Lead the team in Capex equipment identification and installations. Lead the team in developing and tracking ROI on Capex investments. Document and track all cost savings against targets. Lead the evaluation of production activities through data analysis to identify opportunities for improvements in productivity, material flow, and cost reduction. Prioritize actions to be taken, establish schedules for completion, and implement the necessary measures to realize savings. Drive LEAN principles throughout the Operations department. Train operations personnel on LEAN principles. Develop Value Stream Maps for core processes and Lead Rapid Improvement Events (Kaizen). Plan and execute facility layout modifications based on planned products and workload to optimize material and product flow. Support production operations through work cell planning and layout. Justify, procure, and implement necessary production equipment and other assets. Develop, design, and implement appropriate tooling to maximize labor efficiency and total cost savings. Lead the labor estimating function by providing estimates of direct labor as required. Develop and maintain cost models for various activities for use in estimating. Conduct time studies and audits as appropriate to validate and adjust labor estimates to reflect actual costs. Support make/buy analysis of fabricated parts and subassemblies. Support all health, safety, and environmental objectives of the company. Troubleshoot day-to-day operations. Foster a climate of continuous improvement and champion LEAN and 5S activities through specific training and certification of LEAN practitioners within the organization. Collaborate closely with production supervisors and OPM's to maximize overall efficiency of operations in project execution.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
10 Or more years of experience in manufacturing/industrial engineering
A solid understanding of, and experience in implementing, LEAN initiatives, including leading Rapid Improvement (Kaizen) events and Value Stream Mapping
Relevant experience in a make to order/engineer to order project environment
Experienced in the implementation and use of ERP systems
BS in Manufacturing or Industrial engineering, or equivalent
LEAN Manufacturing
Factory Acceptance Testing
Adaptability – Maintaining effectiveness when experiencing major changes in work tasks or the work environment; adjusting effectively to work within new work structures, processes, requirements, or cultures
Building Strategic Working Relationships – Developing and using collaborative relationships to facilitate the accomplishment of work goals
Building Trust – Interacting with others in a way that gives them confidence in one's intentions and those of the organization
Communication – Clearly conveying information and ideas through a variety of media to individuals or groups in a manner that engages the audience and helps them understand and retain the message
Customer Focus – Making customers and their needs a primary focus of one's actions; developing and sustaining productive customer relationships
Decision Making – Identifying and understanding issues, problems, and opportunities; comparing data from different sources to draw conclusions; using effective approaches for choosing a course of action or developing appropriate solutions; taking action that is consistent with available facts, constraints, and probable consequences
Inclusion – Appreciating and leveraging the capabilities, insights, and ideas of all individuals. Working effectively with individuals of diverse style, ability, and motivation for a direct effect on business results
Initiating Action – Taking prompt action to accomplish objectives; taking action to achieve goals beyond what is required; being proactive; generating innovative solutions in work situations
Safety Awareness – Identifying and correcting conditions that affect employee safety, upholding safety standards
Work Standards – Setting high standards of performance for self and others; assuming responsibility and accountability for successfully completing assignments or tasks; self-imposing standards of excellence rather than having standards imposed
PC proficiency – must be versed in the use of basic Microsoft office tools – Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Project
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree in industrial or mechanical engineering
Six Sigma Green belt certification
Welding and NDE experience and training

cond_0022.responsibilities:

The Senior Manufacturing Engineer will lead the manufacturing engineering department to support production operations. The position requires a results-oriented individual with a history of driving change in their work environment, strong analytical skills, and previous experience in an engineer to order / make to order project environment. Primary objectives are to drive continuous improvement and document processes and procedures critical to sustainable manufacturing performance.
Peer relationships include Production, Operations Project Manager, Design Engineering, Planning, Estimating and Facilitates departments.
This individual will facilitate and/or lead cross-functional teams with Engineering, Production and Estimating in support of driving efficiencies, eliminating non-value-added activities, and employing structured improvement methodologies, including LEAN principles. Responsible for training, building, and certifying a capability of continuous and sustainable improvement.
cond_0055.responsibilities: Lead the ME Team in driving Process Improvement Program to meet the savings target. Lead the team in Capex equipment identification and installations. Lead the team in developing and tracking ROI on Capex investments. Document and track all cost savings against targets. Lead the evaluation of production activities through data analysis to identify opportunities for improvements in productivity, material flow, and cost reduction. Prioritize actions to be taken, establish schedules for completion, and implement the necessary measures to realize savings. Drive LEAN principles throughout the Operations department. Train operations personnel on LEAN principles. Develop Value Stream Maps for core processes and Lead Rapid Improvement Events (Kaizen). Plan and execute facility layout modifications based on planned products and workload to optimize material and product flow. Support production operations through work cell planning and layout. Justify, procure, and implement necessary production equipment and other assets. Develop, design, and implement appropriate tooling to maximize labor efficiency and total cost savings. Lead the labor estimating function by providing estimates of direct labor as required. Develop and maintain cost models for various activities for use in estimating. Conduct time studies and audits as appropriate to validate and adjust labor estimates to reflect actual costs. Support make/buy analysis of fabricated parts and subassemblies. Support all health, safety, and environmental objectives of the company. Troubleshoot day-to-day operations. Foster a climate of continuous improvement and champion LEAN and 5S activities through specific training and certification of LEAN practitioners within the organization. Collaborate closely with production supervisors and OPM's to maximize overall efficiency of operations in project execution.
cond_0055.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
10 Or more years of experience in manufacturing/industrial engineering
A solid understanding of, and experience in implementing, LEAN initiatives, including leading Rapid Improvement (Kaizen) events and Value Stream Mapping
Relevant experience in a make to order/engineer to order project environment
Experienced in the implementation and use of ERP systems
BS in Manufacturing or Industrial engineering, or equivalent
LEAN Manufacturing
Factory Acceptance Testing
Adaptability – Maintaining effectiveness when experiencing major changes in work tasks or the work environment; adjusting effectively to work within new work structures, processes, requirements, or cultures
Building Strategic Working Relationships – Developing and using collaborative relationships to facilitate the accomplishment of work goals
Building Trust – Interacting with others in a way that gives them confidence in one's intentions and those of the organization
Communication – Clearly conveying information and ideas through a variety of media to individuals or groups in a manner that engages the audience and helps them understand and retain the message
Customer Focus – Making customers and their needs a primary focus of one's actions; developing and sustaining productive customer relationships
Decision Making – Identifying and understanding issues, problems, and opportunities; comparing data from different sources to draw conclusions; using effective approaches for choosing a course of action or developing appropriate solutions; taking action that is consistent with available facts, constraints, and probable consequences
Inclusion – Appreciating and leveraging the capabilities, insights, and ideas of all individuals. Working effectively with individuals of diverse style, ability, and motivation for a direct effect on business results
Initiating Action – Taking prompt action to accomplish objectives; taking action to achieve goals beyond what is required; being proactive; generating innovative solutions in work situations
Safety Awareness – Identifying and correcting conditions that affect employee safety, upholding safety standards
Work Standards – Setting high standards of performance for self and others; assuming responsibility and accountability for successfully completing assignments or tasks; self-imposing standards of excellence rather than having standards imposed
PC proficiency – must be versed in the use of basic Microsoft office tools – Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Project
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree in industrial or mechanical engineering
Six Sigma Green belt certification
Welding and NDE experience and training

cond_0076.intro:
The Senior Manufacturing Engineer will lead the manufacturing engineering department to support production operations. The position requires a results-oriented individual with a history of driving change in their work environment, strong analytical skills, and previous experience in an engineer to order / make to order project environment. Primary objectives are to drive continuous improvement and document processes and procedures critical to sustainable manufacturing performance.
Peer relationships include Production, Operations Project Manager, Design Engineering, Planning, Estimating and Facilitates departments.
This individual will facilitate and/or lead cross-functional teams with Engineering, Production and Estimating in support of driving efficiencies, eliminating non-value-added activities, and employing structured improvement methodologies, including LEAN principles. Responsible for training, building, and certifying a capability of continuous and sustainable improvement. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of manufacturing processes and improvement methodologies.
cond_0076.responsibilities:
Lead the ME Team in driving Process Improvement Program to meet the savings target. Lead the team in Capex equipment identification and installations. Lead the team in developing and tracking ROI on Capex investments. Document and track all cost savings against targets. Lead the evaluation of production activities through data analysis to identify opportunities for improvements in productivity, material flow, and cost reduction. Prioritize actions to be taken, establish schedules for completion, and implement the necessary measures to realize savings. Drive LEAN principles throughout the Operations department. Train operations personnel on LEAN principles. Develop Value Stream Maps for core processes and Lead Rapid Improvement Events (Kaizen). Plan and execute facility layout modifications based on planned products and workload to optimize material and product flow. Support production operations through work cell planning and layout. Justify, procure, and implement necessary production equipment and other assets. Develop, design, and implement appropriate tooling to maximize labor efficiency and total cost savings. Lead the labor estimating function by providing estimates of direct labor as required. Develop and maintain cost models for various activities for use in estimating. Conduct time studies and audits as appropriate to validate and adjust labor estimates to reflect actual costs. Support make/buy analysis of fabricated parts and subassemblies. Support all health, safety, and environmental objectives of the company. Troubleshoot day-to-day operations. Foster a climate of continuous improvement and champion LEAN and 5S activities through specific training and certification of LEAN practitioners within the organization. Collaborate closely with production supervisors and OPM's to maximize overall efficiency of operations in project execution.
Job Skills
Adaptability – Maintaining effectiveness when experiencing major changes in work tasks or the work environment; adjusting effectively to work within new work structures, processes, requirements, or cultures. Building Strategic Working Relationships – Developing and using collaborative relationships to facilitate the accomplishment of work goals. Building Trust – Interacting with others in a way that gives them confidence in one's intentions and those of the organization. Communication – Clearly conveying information and ideas through a variety of media to individuals or groups in a manner that engages the audience and helps them understand and retain the message. Customer Focus – Making customers and their needs a primary focus of one's actions; developing and sustaining productive customer relationships. Decision Making – Identifying and understanding issues, problems, and opportunities; comparing data from different sources to draw conclusions; using effective approaches for choosing a course of action or developing appropriate solutions; taking action that is consistent with available facts, constraints, and probable consequences. Inclusion – Appreciating and leveraging the capabilities, insights, and ideas of all individuals. Working effectively with individuals of diverse style, ability, and motivation for a direct effect on business results. Initiating Action – Taking prompt action to accomplish objectives; taking action to achieve goals beyond what is required; being proactive; generating innovative solutions in work situations. Safety Awareness – Identifying and correcting conditions that affect employee safety, upholding safety standards. Work Standards – Setting high standards of performance for self and others; assuming responsibility and accountability for successfully completing assignments or tasks; self-imposing standards of excellence rather than having standards imposed. PC proficiency – must be versed in the use of basic Microsoft office tools – Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Project.

cond_0154.intro: We are looking for a Sr. Manufacturing Engineer to join our team.
cond_0154.responsibilities:
Lead the ME Team in driving Process Improvement Program to meet the savings target.
Lead the team in Capex equipment identification and installations.
Lead the team in developing and tracking ROI on Capex investments.
Document and track all cost savings against targets.
Lead the evaluation of production activities through data analysis to identify opportunities for improvements in productivity, material flow, and cost reduction.
Prioritize actions to be taken, establish schedules for completion, and implement the necessary measures to realize savings.
Drive LEAN principles throughout the Operations department.
Train operations personnel on LEAN principles.
Develop Value Stream Maps for core processes and Lead Rapid Improvement Events (Kaizen).
Plan and execute facility layout modifications based on planned products and workload to optimize material and product flow.
Support production operations through work cell planning and layout.
Justify, procure, and implement necessary production equipment and other assets.
Develop, design, and implement appropriate tooling to maximize labor efficiency and total cost savings.
Lead the labor estimating function by providing estimates of direct labor as required.
Develop and maintain cost models for various activities for use in estimating.
Conduct time studies and audits as appropriate to validate and adjust labor estimates to reflect actual costs.
Support make/buy analysis of fabricated parts and subassemblies.
Support all health, safety, and environmental objectives of the company.
Troubleshoot day-to-day operations.
Foster a climate of continuous improvement and champion LEAN and 5S activities through specific training and certification of LEAN practitioners within the organization.
Collaborate closely with production supervisors and OPM's to maximize overall efficiency of operations in project execution.
cond_0154.requirements:
Adaptability – Maintaining effectiveness when experiencing major changes in work tasks or the work environment; adjusting effectively to work within new work structures, processes, requirements, or cultures.
Building Strategic Working Relationships – Developing and using collaborative relationships to facilitate the accomplishment of work goals.
Building Trust – Interacting with others in a way that gives them confidence in one's intentions and those of the organization.
Communication – Clearly conveying information and ideas through a variety of media to individuals or groups in a manner that engages the audience and helps them understand and retain the message.
Customer Focus – Making customers and their needs a primary focus of one's actions; developing and sustaining productive customer relationships.
Decision Making – Identifying and understanding issues, problems, and opportunities; comparing data from different sources to draw conclusions; using effective approaches for choosing a course of action or developing appropriate solutions; taking action that is consistent with available facts, constraints, and probable consequences.
Inclusion – Appreciating and leveraging the capabilities, insights, and ideas of all individuals. Working effectively with individuals of diverse style, ability, and motivation for a direct effect on business results.
Initiating Action – Taking prompt action to accomplish objectives; taking action to achieve goals beyond what is required; being proactive; generating innovative solutions in work situations.
Safety Awareness – Identifying and correcting conditions that affect employee safety, upholding safety standards.
Work Standards – Setting high standards of performance for self and others; assuming responsibility and accountability for successfully completing assignments or tasks; self-imposing standards of excellence rather than having standards imposed.
PC proficiency – must be versed in the use of basic Microsoft office tools – Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Project.
BS in Manufacturing or Industrial engineering, or equivalent.
LEAN Manufacturing.
Factory Acceptance Testing.
10 Or more years of experience in manufacturing/industrial engineering.
A solid understanding of, and experience in implementing, LEAN initiatives, including leading Rapid Improvement (Kaizen) events and Value Stream Mapping.
Relevant experience in a make to order/engineer to order project environment.
Experienced in the implementation and use of ERP systems.
Master's degree in industrial or mechanical engineering.
Six Sigma Green belt certification is preferred.
Welding and NDE experience and training.

The position requires a results-oriented individual with a history of driving change in their work environment, strong analytical skills, and previous experience in an engineer to order / make to order project environment. Primary objectives are to drive continuous improvement and document processes and procedures critical to sustainable manufacturing performance.
Peer relationships include Production, Operations Project Manager, Design Engineering, Planning, Estimating and Facilitates departments.
This individual will facilitate and/or lead cross-functional teams with Engineering, Production and Estimating in support of driving efficiencies, eliminating non-value-added activities, and employing structured improvement methodologies, including LEAN principles. Responsible for training, building, and certifying a capability of continuous and sustainable improvement. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of manufacturing processes and improvement methodologies.
cond_0175.responsibilities: Lead the ME Team in driving Process Improvement Program to meet the savings target. Lead the team in Capex equipment identification and installations. Lead the team in developing and tracking ROI on Capex investments. Document and track all cost savings against targets. Lead the evaluation of production activities through data analysis to identify opportunities for improvements in productivity, material flow, and cost reduction. Prioritize actions to be taken, establish schedules for completion, and implement the necessary measures to realize savings. Drive LEAN principles throughout the Operations department. Train operations personnel on LEAN principles. Develop Value Stream Maps for core processes and Lead Rapid Improvement Events (Kaizen). Plan and execute facility layout modifications based on planned products and workload to optimize material and product flow. Support production operations through work cell planning and layout. Justify, procure, and implement necessary production equipment and other assets. Develop, design, and implement appropriate tooling to maximize labor efficiency and total cost savings. Lead the labor estimating function by providing estimates of direct labor as required. Develop and maintain cost models for various activities for use in estimating. Conduct time studies and audits as appropriate to validate and adjust labor estimates to reflect actual costs. Support make/buy analysis of fabricated parts and subassemblies. Support all health, safety, and environmental objectives of the company. Troubleshoot day-to-day operations. Foster a climate of continuous improvement and champion LEAN and 5S activities through specific training and certification of LEAN practitioners within the organization. Collaborate closely with production supervisors and OPM's to maximize overall efficiency of operations in project execution.
cond_0175.requirements:
Adaptability – Maintaining effectiveness when experiencing major changes in work tasks or the work environment; adjusting effectively to work within new work structures, processes, requirements, or cultures. Building Strategic Working Relationships – Developing and using collaborative relationships to facilitate the accomplishment of work goals. Building Trust – Interacting with others in a way that gives them confidence in one's intentions and those of the organization. Communication – Clearly conveying information and ideas through a variety of media to individuals or groups in a manner that engages the audience and helps them understand and retain the message. Customer Focus – Making customers and their needs a primary focus of one's actions; developing and sustaining productive customer relationships. Decision Making – Identifying and understanding issues, problems, and opportunities; comparing data from different sources to draw conclusions; using effective approaches for choosing a course of action or developing appropriate solutions; taking action that is consistent with available facts, constraints, and probable consequences. Inclusion – Appreciating and leveraging the capabilities, insights, and ideas of all individuals. Working effectively with individuals of diverse style, ability, and motivation for a direct effect on business results. Initiating Action – Taking prompt action to accomplish objectives; taking action to achieve goals beyond what is required; being proactive; generating innovative solutions in work situations. Safety Awareness – Identifying and correcting conditions that affect employee safety, upholding safety standards. Work Standards – Setting high standards of performance for self and others; assuming responsibility and accountability for successfully completing assignments or tasks; self-imposing standards of excellence rather than having standards imposed. PC proficiency – must be versed in the use of basic Microsoft office tools – Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Project.
BS in Manufacturing or Industrial engineering, or equivalent. LEAN Manufacturing. Factory Acceptance Testing.
10 Or more years of experience in manufacturing/industrial engineering. A solid understanding of, and experience in implementing, LEAN initiatives, including leading Rapid Improvement (Kaizen) events and Value Stream Mapping. Relevant experience in a make to order/engineer to order project environment. Experienced in the implementation and use of ERP systems. Master's degree in industrial or mechanical engineering. Six Sigma Green belt certification is preferred. Welding and NDE experience and training.
Position is at least 80% to 95% at a desk working with computer. Ability to exert up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Performs other physical activities including use of fingers, sitting, stooping, bending, crouching, talking, hearing, and performing repetitive motions. Visual acuity requirements include color, depth perception and field of vision necessary to prepare and analyze data and figures, operate a computer terminal, and conduct extensive reading. The incumbent will be subject to inside environmental conditions.

Primary objectives are to support continuous improvement and document processes and procedures critical to sustainable manufacturing performance.
Peer relationships include Production, Operations Project Manager, Design Engineering, Planning, Estimating, and Facilities departments.
This individual will facilitate and coordinate cross-functional teams with Engineering, Production, and Estimating to support efficiencies, eliminate non-value-added activities, and apply structured improvement methodologies, including LEAN principles. cond_0189.responsibilities:

Support the evaluation of production activities through data analysis to identify opportunities for improvements in productivity, material flow, and cost reduction.

Help spread LEAN principles throughout the Operations department.
Train operations personnel on LEAN principles.
Develop Value Stream Maps for core processes and coordinate Rapid Improvement Events (Kaizen).

Help troubleshoot day-to-day operations.

The position requires a results-oriented individual with a history of driving change in their work environment, strong analytical skills, and previous experience in an engineer to order / make to order project environment. Primary objectives are to drive continuous improvement and document processes and procedures critical to sustainable manufacturing performance.
This individual will regularly work with and facilitate cross-functional teams across Engineering, Production, and Estimating to drive efficiencies, eliminate non-value-added activities, and apply structured improvement methodologies, including LEAN principles. Day-to-day peer relationships include Production, Operations Project Manager, Design Engineering, Planning, Estimating, and Facilities departments. Responsible for training, building, and certifying a capability of continuous and sustainable improvement.
cond_0204.responsibilities:
Lead the ME Team in driving Process Improvement Program to meet the savings target. Lead the team in Capex equipment identification and installations. Lead the team in developing and tracking ROI on Capex investments. Document and track all cost savings against targets. Lead the evaluation of production activities through data analysis to identify opportunities for improvements in productivity, material flow, and cost reduction. Prioritize actions to be taken, establish schedules for completion, and implement the necessary measures to realize savings. Drive LEAN principles throughout the Operations department. Train operations personnel on LEAN principles. Develop Value Stream Maps for core processes and lead Rapid Improvement Events (Kaizen). Plan and execute facility layout modifications based on planned products and workload to optimize material and product flow. Support production operations through work cell planning and layout. Justify, procure, and implement necessary production equipment and other assets. Develop, design, and implement appropriate tooling to maximize labor efficiency and total cost savings. Lead the labor estimating function by providing estimates of direct labor as required. Develop and maintain cost models for various activities for use in estimating. Conduct time studies and audits as appropriate to validate and adjust labor estimates to reflect actual costs. Support make/buy analysis of fabricated parts and subassemblies. Support all health, safety, and environmental objectives of the company. Troubleshoot day-to-day operations. Foster a climate of continuous improvement and champion LEAN and 5S activities through specific training and certification of LEAN practitioners within the organization. Collaborate closely and regularly with production supervisors and OPMs to maximize overall efficiency of operations in project execution.
Job Skills
Adaptability – Maintaining effectiveness when experiencing major changes in work tasks or the work environment; adjusting effectively to work within new work structures, processes, requirements, or cultures. Building Strategic Working Relationships – Developing and using collaborative relationships to facilitate the accomplishment of work goals. Building Trust – Interacting with others in a way that gives them confidence in one's intentions and those of the organization. Communication – Clearly conveying information and ideas through a variety of media to individuals or groups in a manner that engages the audience and helps them understand and retain the message. Customer Focus – Making customers and their needs a primary focus of one's actions; developing and sustaining productive customer relationships. Decision Making – Identifying and understanding issues, problems, and opportunities; comparing data from different sources to draw conclusions; using effective approaches for choosing a course of action or developing appropriate solutions; taking action that is consistent with available facts, constraints, and probable consequences. Inclusion – Appreciating and leveraging the capabilities, insights, and ideas of all individuals. Working effectively with individuals of diverse style, ability, and motivation for a direct effect on business results. Initiating Action – Taking prompt action to accomplish objectives; taking action to achieve goals beyond what is required; being proactive; generating innovative solutions in work situations. Safety Awareness – Identifying and correcting conditions that affect employee safety, upholding safety standards. Work Standards – Setting high standards of performance for self and others; assuming responsibility and accountability for successfully completing assignments or tasks; self-imposing standards of excellence rather than having standards imposed. PC proficiency – must be versed in the use of basic Microsoft office tools – Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Project.
cond_0204.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
10 Or more years of experience in manufacturing/industrial engineering
BS in Manufacturing or Industrial Engineering, or equivalent
A solid understanding of, and experience implementing, LEAN initiatives, including leading Rapid Improvement (Kaizen) events and Value Stream Mapping
Relevant experience in a make to order/engineer to order project environment
Experienced in the implementation and use of ERP systems
LEAN Manufacturing knowledge
Ability to actively communicate and work across teams including Engineering, Production, and Estimating on a regular basis
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree in Industrial or Mechanical Engineering
Six Sigma Green Belt certification
Welding and NDE experience and training
Factory Acceptance Testing experience
cond_0204.values: We value creating outcomes that are useful, fair, and mindful of the people they affect. We aim to approach our work with responsibility and respect.

cond_0261.intro:
The Senior Manufacturing Engineer will work alongside the manufacturing engineering department to support production operations. The role calls for someone with strong analytical skills and experience in an engineer-to-order / make-to-order project environment. Primary objectives are to support continuous improvement and document processes and procedures critical to sustainable manufacturing performance.
Peer relationships include Production, Operations Project Manager, Design Engineering, Planning, Estimating, and Facilities departments.
This individual will facilitate and coordinate cross-functional teams with Engineering, Production, and Estimating to support efficiencies, eliminate non-value-added activities, and apply structured improvement methodologies, including LEAN principles. Coordinate with the ME Team to advance the Process Improvement Program and meet savings targets.
Work with the team on Capex equipment identification and installations.
Collaborate with the team to develop and track ROI on Capex investments.
Document and track all cost savings against targets.
Support the evaluation of production activities through data analysis to identify opportunities for improvements in productivity, material flow, and cost reduction.
Coordinate prioritization of actions, establish schedules for completion, and help implement measures to realize savings.
Help spread LEAN principles throughout the Operations department.
Train operations personnel on LEAN principles.
Develop Value Stream Maps for core processes and coordinate Rapid Improvement Events (Kaizen).
Work with relevant teams to plan and execute facility layout modifications based on planned products and workload to optimize material and product flow.
Support production operations through work cell planning and layout.
Coordinate the justification, procurement, and implementation of necessary production equipment and other assets.

Support the labor estimating function by providing estimates of direct labor as required.
Develop and maintain cost models for various activities for use in estimating.
Conduct time studies and audits as appropriate to validate and adjust labor estimates to reflect actual costs.
Support make/buy analysis of fabricated parts and subassemblies.
Support all health, safety, and environmental objectives of the company.
Help troubleshoot day-to-day operations.
Foster a climate of continuous improvement and work with others to champion LEAN and 5S activities through specific training and certification of LEAN practitioners within the organization.
Work closely with production supervisors and OPMs to support overall efficiency of operations in project execution.

cond_0315.intro:

The role calls for someone with strong analytical skills and experience in an engineer-to-order / make-to-order project environment. Primary objectives are to support continuous improvement and document processes and procedures critical to sustainable manufacturing performance.
Peer relationships include Production, Operations Project Manager, Design Engineering, Planning, Estimating, and Facilities departments.
This individual will facilitate and coordinate cross-functional teams with Engineering, Production, and Estimating to support efficiencies, eliminate non-value-added activities, and apply structured improvement methodologies, including LEAN principles. cond_0315.responsibilities:
Coordinate with the ME Team to advance the Process Improvement Program and meet savings targets.
Work with the team on Capex equipment identification and installations.
Collaborate with the team to develop and track ROI on Capex investments.
Document and track all cost savings against targets.
Support the evaluation of production activities through data analysis to identify opportunities for improvements in productivity, material flow, and cost reduction.
Coordinate prioritization of actions, establish schedules for completion, and help implement measures to realize savings.
Help spread LEAN principles throughout the Operations department.
Train operations personnel on LEAN principles.
Develop Value Stream Maps for core processes and coordinate Rapid Improvement Events (Kaizen).
Work with relevant teams to plan and execute facility layout modifications based on planned products and workload to optimize material and product flow.
Support production operations through work cell planning and layout.
Coordinate the justification, procurement, and implementation of necessary production equipment and other assets.
Develop, design, and implement appropriate tooling in coordination with production to maximize labor efficiency and total cost savings.
Support the labor estimating function by providing estimates of direct labor as required.
Develop and maintain cost models for various activities for use in estimating.
Conduct time studies and audits as appropriate to validate and adjust labor estimates to reflect actual costs.
Support make/buy analysis of fabricated parts and subassemblies.
Support all health, safety, and environmental objectives of the company.
Help troubleshoot day-to-day operations.

cond_0337.intro:
The Senior Manufacturing Engineer will lead the manufacturing engineering department to support production operations. The position requires a results-oriented individual with a history of driving change in their work environment, strong analytical skills, and previous experience in an engineer to order / make to order project environment. Primary objectives are to drive continuous improvement and document processes and procedures critical to sustainable manufacturing performance.
Peer relationships include Production, Operations Project Manager, Design Engineering, Planning, Estimating and Facilitates departments.
This individual will facilitate and/or lead cross-functional teams with Engineering, Production and Estimating in support of driving efficiencies, eliminating non-value-added activities, and employing structured improvement methodologies, including LEAN principles. Responsible for training, building, and certifying a capability of continuous and sustainable improvement. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of manufacturing processes and improvement methodologies.
cond_0337.responsibilities: Lead the ME Team in driving Process Improvement Program to meet the savings target. Lead the team in Capex equipment identification and installations. Lead the team in developing and tracking ROI on Capex investments. Document and track all cost savings against targets. Lead the evaluation of production activities through data analysis to identify opportunities for improvements in productivity, material flow, and cost reduction. Prioritize actions to be taken, establish schedules for completion, and implement the necessary measures to realize savings. Drive LEAN principles throughout the Operations department. Train operations personnel on LEAN principles. Develop Value Stream Maps for core processes and Lead Rapid Improvement Events (Kaizen). Plan and execute facility layout modifications based on planned products and workload to optimize material and product flow. Support production operations through work cell planning and layout. Justify, procure, and implement necessary production equipment and other assets. Develop, design, and implement appropriate tooling to maximize labor efficiency and total cost savings. Lead the labor estimating function by providing estimates of direct labor as required. Develop and maintain cost models for various activities for use in estimating. Conduct time studies and audits as appropriate to validate and adjust labor estimates to reflect actual costs. Support make/buy analysis of fabricated parts and subassemblies. Support all health, safety, and environmental objectives of the company. Troubleshoot day-to-day operations. Foster a climate of continuous improvement and champion LEAN and 5S activities through specific training and certification of LEAN practitioners within the organization. Collaborate closely with production supervisors and OPM's to maximize overall efficiency of operations in project execution.
cond_0337.requirements:
Adaptability – Maintaining effectiveness when experiencing major changes in work tasks or the work environment; adjusting effectively to work within new work structures, processes, requirements, or cultures. Building Strategic Working Relationships – Developing and using collaborative relationships to facilitate the accomplishment of work goals. Building Trust – Interacting with others in a way that gives them confidence in one's intentions and those of the organization. Communication – Clearly conveying information and ideas through a variety of media to individuals or groups in a manner that engages the audience and helps them understand and retain the message. Customer Focus – Making customers and their needs a primary focus of one's actions; developing and sustaining productive customer relationships. Decision Making – Identifying and understanding issues, problems, and opportunities; comparing data from different sources to draw conclusions; using effective approaches for choosing a course of action or developing appropriate solutions; taking action that is consistent with available facts, constraints, and probable consequences. Inclusion – Appreciating and leveraging the capabilities, insights, and ideas of all individuals. Working effectively with individuals of diverse style, ability, and motivation for a direct effect on business results. Initiating Action – Taking prompt action to accomplish objectives; taking action to achieve goals beyond what is required; being proactive; generating innovative solutions in work situations. Safety Awareness – Identifying and correcting conditions that affect employee safety, upholding safety standards. Work Standards – Setting high standards of performance for self and others; assuming responsibility and accountability for successfully completing assignments or tasks; self-imposing standards of excellence rather than having standards imposed. PC proficiency – must be versed in the use of basic Microsoft office tools – Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Project.
BS in Manufacturing or Industrial engineering, or equivalent. LEAN Manufacturing. Factory Acceptance Testing.
10 Or more years of experience in manufacturing/industrial engineering. A solid understanding of, and experience in implementing, LEAN initiatives, including leading Rapid Improvement (Kaizen) events and Value Stream Mapping. Relevant experience in a make to order/engineer to order project environment. Experienced in the implementation and use of ERP systems. Master's degree in industrial or mechanical engineering. Six Sigma Green belt certification is preferred. Welding and NDE experience and training.
Position is at least 80% to 95% at a desk working with computer. Ability to exert up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Performs other physical activities including use of fingers, sitting, stooping, bending, crouching, talking, hearing, and performing repetitive motions. Visual acuity requirements include color, depth perception and field of vision necessary to prepare and analyze data and figures, operate a computer terminal, and conduct extensive reading. The incumbent will be subject to inside environmental conditions.

Primary objectives are to support continuous improvement and document processes and procedures critical to sustainable manufacturing performance.
Peer relationships include Production, Operations Project Manager, Design Engineering, Planning, Estimating, and Facilities departments.

cond_0372.intro: We are looking for a Sr. Manufacturing Engineer to join our team.
cond_0372.responsibilities: Lead the ME Team in driving Process Improvement Program to meet the savings target. Lead the team in Capex equipment identification and installations. Lead the team in developing and tracking ROI on Capex investments. Document and track all cost savings against targets. Lead the evaluation of production activities through data analysis to identify opportunities for improvements in productivity, material flow, and cost reduction. Prioritize actions to be taken, establish schedules for completion, and implement the necessary measures to realize savings. Drive LEAN principles throughout the Operations department. Train operations personnel on LEAN principles. Develop Value Stream Maps for core processes and Lead Rapid Improvement Events (Kaizen). Plan and execute facility layout modifications based on planned products and workload to optimize material and product flow. Support production operations through work cell planning and layout. Justify, procure, and implement necessary production equipment and other assets. Develop, design, and implement appropriate tooling to maximize labor efficiency and total cost savings. Lead the labor estimating function by providing estimates of direct labor as required. Develop and maintain cost models for various activities for use in estimating. Conduct time studies and audits as appropriate to validate and adjust labor estimates to reflect actual costs. Support make/buy analysis of fabricated parts and subassemblies. Support all health, safety, and environmental objectives of the company. Troubleshoot day-to-day operations. Foster a climate of continuous improvement and champion LEAN and 5S activities through specific training and certification of LEAN practitioners within the organization. Collaborate closely with production supervisors and OPM's to maximize overall efficiency of operations in project execution.
cond_0372.requirements:
Around 10 years of experience in manufacturing/industrial engineering, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
A working knowledge of LEAN initiatives, including experience with leading Rapid Improvement (Kaizen) events and Value Stream Mapping — candidates still building depth in this area are welcome to apply.
Some background in a make to order/engineer to order project environment.
Familiarity with ERP systems and their implementation and use.
BS in Manufacturing or Industrial Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Master's degree in industrial or mechanical engineering is a plus.
Six Sigma Green Belt certification is preferred, or willingness to obtain.
Exposure to welding and NDE experience and training.
Comfort with basic Microsoft Office tools — Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Project.
Ability to communicate clearly and work collaboratively across teams.
Willingness to adapt and openness to feedback in a changing work environment.

The position requires a results-oriented individual with a history of driving change in their work environment, strong analytical skills, and previous experience in an engineer to order / make to order project environment. Primary objectives are to drive continuous improvement and document processes and procedures critical to sustainable manufacturing performance.
Peer relationships include Production, Operations Project Manager, Design Engineering, Planning, Estimating and Facilitates departments.
This individual will facilitate and/or lead cross-functional teams with Engineering, Production and Estimating in support of driving efficiencies, eliminating non-value-added activities, and employing structured improvement methodologies, including LEAN principles. Responsible for training, building, and certifying a capability of continuous and sustainable improvement. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with manufacturing engineering and continuous improvement work.
cond_0437.responsibilities: Lead the ME Team in driving Process Improvement Program to meet the savings target. Lead the team in Capex equipment identification and installations. Lead the team in developing and tracking ROI on Capex investments. Document and track all cost savings against targets. Lead the evaluation of production activities through data analysis to identify opportunities for improvements in productivity, material flow, and cost reduction. Prioritize actions to be taken, establish schedules for completion, and implement the necessary measures to realize savings. Drive LEAN principles throughout the Operations department. Train operations personnel on LEAN principles. Develop Value Stream Maps for core processes and Lead Rapid Improvement Events (Kaizen). Plan and execute facility layout modifications based on planned products and workload to optimize material and product flow. Support production operations through work cell planning and layout. Justify, procure, and implement necessary production equipment and other assets. Develop, design, and implement appropriate tooling to maximize labor efficiency and total cost savings. Lead the labor estimating function by providing estimates of direct labor as required. Develop and maintain cost models for various activities for use in estimating. Conduct time studies and audits as appropriate to validate and adjust labor estimates to reflect actual costs. Support make/buy analysis of fabricated parts and subassemblies. Support all health, safety, and environmental objectives of the company. Troubleshoot day-to-day operations. Foster a climate of continuous improvement and champion LEAN and 5S activities through specific training and certification of LEAN practitioners within the organization. Collaborate closely with production supervisors and OPM's to maximize overall efficiency of operations in project execution.
cond_0437.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
10 Or more years of experience in manufacturing/industrial engineering
BS in Manufacturing or Industrial engineering, or equivalent
A solid understanding of, and experience in implementing, LEAN initiatives, including leading Rapid Improvement (Kaizen) events and Value Stream Mapping
Relevant experience in a make to order/engineer to order project environment
Experienced in the implementation and use of ERP systems
PC proficiency – must be versed in the use of basic Microsoft office tools – Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Project
Adaptability – Maintaining effectiveness when experiencing major changes in work tasks or the work environment; adjusting effectively to work within new work structures, processes, requirements, or cultures
Building Strategic Working Relationships – Developing and using collaborative relationships to facilitate the accomplishment of work goals
Building Trust – Interacting with others in a way that gives them confidence in one's intentions and those of the organization
Communication – Clearly conveying information and ideas through a variety of media to individuals or groups in a manner that engages the audience and helps them understand and retain the message
Customer Focus – Making customers and their needs a primary focus of one's actions; developing and sustaining productive customer relationships
Decision Making – Identifying and understanding issues, problems, and opportunities; comparing data from different sources to draw conclusions; using effective approaches for choosing a course of action or developing appropriate solutions; taking action that is consistent with available facts, constraints, and probable consequences
Inclusion – Appreciating and leveraging the capabilities, insights, and ideas of all individuals. Working effectively with individuals of diverse style, ability, and motivation for a direct effect on business results
Initiating Action – Taking prompt action to accomplish objectives; taking action to achieve goals beyond what is required; being proactive; generating innovative solutions in work situations
Safety Awareness – Identifying and correcting conditions that affect employee safety, upholding safety standards
Work Standards – Setting high standards of performance for self and others; assuming responsibility and accountability for successfully completing assignments or tasks; self-imposing standards of excellence rather than having standards imposed
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree in industrial or mechanical engineering
Six Sigma Green belt certification
Welding and NDE experience and training
LEAN Manufacturing certification
Factory Acceptance Testing experience

cond_0479.intro:
The Senior Manufacturing Engineer will lead the manufacturing engineering department to support production operations. The position requires a results-oriented individual with a history of driving change in their work environment, strong analytical skills, and previous experience in an engineer to order / make to order project environment. Primary objectives are to drive continuous improvement and document processes and procedures critical to sustainable manufacturing performance.
Peer relationships include Production, Operations Project Manager, Design Engineering, Planning, Estimating and Facilitates departments.
This individual will facilitate and/or lead cross-functional teams with Engineering, Production and Estimating in support of driving efficiencies, eliminating non-value-added activities, and employing structured improvement methodologies, including LEAN principles. Responsible for training, building, and certifying a capability of continuous and sustainable improvement.
cond_0479.responsibilities: Lead the ME Team in driving Process Improvement Program to meet the savings target. Lead the team in Capex equipment identification and installations. Lead the team in developing and tracking ROI on Capex investments. Document and track all cost savings against targets. Lead the evaluation of production activities through data analysis to identify opportunities for improvements in productivity, material flow, and cost reduction. Prioritize actions to be taken, establish schedules for completion, and implement the necessary measures to realize savings. Drive LEAN principles throughout the Operations department. Train operations personnel on LEAN principles. Develop Value Stream Maps for core processes and Lead Rapid Improvement Events (Kaizen). Plan and execute facility layout modifications based on planned products and workload to optimize material and product flow. Support production operations through work cell planning and layout. Justify, procure, and implement necessary production equipment and other assets. Develop, design, and implement appropriate tooling to maximize labor efficiency and total cost savings. Lead the labor estimating function by providing estimates of direct labor as required. Develop and maintain cost models for various activities for use in estimating. Conduct time studies and audits as appropriate to validate and adjust labor estimates to reflect actual costs. Support make/buy analysis of fabricated parts and subassemblies. Support all health, safety, and environmental objectives of the company. Troubleshoot day-to-day operations. Foster a climate of continuous improvement and champion LEAN and 5S activities through specific training and certification of LEAN practitioners within the organization. Collaborate closely with production supervisors and OPM's to maximize overall efficiency of operations in project execution.
cond_0479.requirements:
10 Or more years of demonstrated expertise in manufacturing/industrial engineering.
Proven track record in implementing LEAN initiatives, including leading Rapid Improvement (Kaizen) events and Value Stream Mapping.
Substantial experience in a make to order/engineer to order project environment.
Deep knowledge of ERP systems implementation and use.
Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing or Industrial Engineering, or equivalent required; Master's degree in Industrial or Mechanical Engineering strongly preferred.
Six Sigma Green Belt certification strongly preferred.
Expertise in LEAN Manufacturing principles and Factory Acceptance Testing.
Welding and NDE experience and training.
Exceptional communication skills — able to clearly convey information and ideas through a variety of media to individuals or groups.
Strong leadership abilities in adaptability, building trust, and initiating action.
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office tools — Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Project.
Solid understanding of safety awareness and work standards, with a consistent record of setting and upholding high performance standards.
